Title: Add performance benchmark trace events for critical MemorySmith flows.
Description: Treat performance benchmarking as a first-class logging capability by emitting structured benchmark and phase-timing events for critical flows (search, memory save/update, page render, chat turn, and maintenance runs). Define a stable event schema with operation name, phase, duration, percentile bucket context, correlation id, and success/failure markers so operators can compare runs over time and quickly identify regressions. Acceptance criteria: benchmark events can be captured in normal logging sinks and queried alongside error events, critical operations include start/stop timing coverage, benchmark sampling and thresholds are configurable in the existing admin configuration, and at least one report path (API or health view) can summarize benchmark trends. Validation: run a repeatable workload, capture benchmark trace events, confirm trend comparisons are available across two runs, and verify benchmark logging controls can be tuned from admin configuration.

Comments.Author: AgentSmith
Comments.Body: Evidence: current health charts focus on memory activity, and the logging review identified no dedicated benchmark-trace schema or first-class latency/percentile event model for critical operations.
